steps.text: It was what left the deepest impression on her current self.
It was the day her 'noble life' came to an end.

steps.name: Phidian Noble
steps.text: You're back.

steps.name: Phidian Noble
steps.text: I thought you weren't fond of that sword. Why carry it on your person?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Just may as well.

steps.name: Phidian Noble
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Phidian Noble
steps.text: The smell of mud is stuck to your clothes. No smell of blood, though, nor anything singed. Your maidservant mentioned you were in a rush to meet me, so much so you did not bathe, nor change. Let me hazard a guess. You haven't done anything.

steps.name: Phidian Noble
steps.text: Did you find a better way, Talulah? Of dealing with this thorn in our side? You found a better way, and thus did not do as I told you to, is that it?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You didn't just want me to eliminate Major Antonio. You tried to trick me into killing a child.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Kashchey... a child. Antonio was taking his son on a trip, and you had me frame him so the Gendarmerie would beat him to death on his way to the next city over. His son would've had no chance of escaping.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Antonio makes an art of covering himself. You should easily have been able to tell that that young boy was not his son.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I've taught you this. In times when we have greater goals, we cannot avoid making sacrifices in our morality and resources.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Given you've let Antonio go, the next time he surfaces may well be in the residence of some Victorian secret service official.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Those horrid Felines would then surely make a fine point of our four neighboring cities' shipping routes for the whole year...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: ...and take it as a pretense to identify our trading partners, investigate our resources, draw an outline of our import and export itineraries, and produce a clear grasp of our defense arrangements.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I've already destroyed the files.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Wonderful! Very well done. You are quite capable, aren't you?

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: But, Talulah, how do you intend to certify... to at all assert, that Antonio 'had never' seen in those records before?

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: If he did not know their contents, why take them with him?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And how would you prove that he'd betray your dukedom? Betray Ursus? Why didn't you go to question him, or seize him? Why go straight to eliminating him?

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I do not need to give proof. Questioning him would grant him the opportunity to dispute his charges and escape punishment. His conduct cannot be pardoned.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: If he may have possibly done so. Then. As far as I'm concerned, as Ursus is concerned, as the laws and decrees are concerned, that is sufficient.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: He cannot. He is not allowed to have 'possibly done so.'

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: —Antonio has already been dealt with. After you destroyed the files, my Scales cleaned up the remainder for you.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I knew it. I just knew... you wouldn't let him go.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I've only been training you ceaselessly so that you may step by step become ever better. Now, you see that you have once again failed my expectations. You did not work as well as you did last time, Talulah.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Your performance at the Shuvata Conference was outstanding, Talulah, and you ought to admit, too, that you revel in how it feels.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: How it feels to stand on a peerless summit.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Don't ridicule me. Everything about you only stokes the anger in me to a roar.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Then you must surely revel even more in the feeling of perfection.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I'm very clear on your misgivings, and I understand how you think, too. That is why...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: The Scales let that boy acting as his son run free.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: How about that, Talulah? That wasn't something out of reach of your lone capability, is it?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The boy in question was his son. Was. His. Son.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: It makes no difference if he wasn't.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: When that boy comes of age, he'll find you, and he'll take revenge for his father.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Then perhaps you should prepare... prepare for some far-flung moment to take revenge for your own father?

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Talulah, the one who killed him is still alive and well, after all.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I've given you this answer before. You must be sufficiently trained to the point you are capable of personally avenging him. Mm. And you currently... are not yet so.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...You can shut up, now, Kashchey!

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Ah, excepting that, Talulah, excepting your own personal wants, I do have ever higher hopes that you may become an outstanding individual.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: An executioner, a lead gendarmerie, a noble officer, a conspirator, a killing machine of a caster?! When you say 'an outstanding individual,' is that what you mean?!

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Talulah, Talulah. No.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I long for an heir.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I never imagined you'd say something so sickening outright.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But, well, *chuckle* I'm sorry, Duke.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Your hopes are all...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Fruitless.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I can see you've gotten fired up. Tell me, then, Talulah, tell me something. What is it you've done that has you so pleased with yourself?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Half a year ago, I got a hold of a small splinter of Originium ore, and can you guess what I did with it...?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I embedded it in my own arm.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: With wonderful results.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I am Infected already.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm an Infected now, Duke Kashchey. My life is wound short, and your schemes, your plans, your investments, all for naught. You have no way to use me ever again.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Everything I am was by your own design, wasn't it? And now, no longer.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Ah. Truly... an unforeseen method.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Does it taste good? The flavor of your conspiracy bled dry?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Kashchey, I've already become what Ursus and the world at large most reviles. We most despicable Infected... across the cities, the tundras, the barrens, we most depraved, lowly Infected.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: And if your sister saw you like this, would she be happy?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Don't you—!

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: What is it that made you scheme, rebel against me so, my daughter?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: —You.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You deceived me. Lied to me, you said Wei Yenwu masterminded the murder of my father. You never told me they confronted you together, drove you out of Lungmen.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You never told me what role you played in my father's death. Even if Wei Yenwu killed him, even if he is guilty, even if he deserves to die for it—

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You can't escape blame either.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: On the surface, you treat your subjects well, help with settling the villages around the city, give the Infected stable residence...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But in actuality, you have the Infected and your residents living entirely different lives—you let the inhabitants feed their own egos on the Infected.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You've taken this city plundering its own residents and embellished it into a duty! To the point that they push around the Infected and the nomadic non-dwellers to bring themselves comfort!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Is this your dukedom, then? Is this your city and your rule?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You use inequality to mold a facade, and a facade to expand your influence?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I cannot endure this any longer. Even if I didn't fault your hypocritical means and twisted tricks, your pathological lies and false benevolence already had me at wit's end!

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I've taught you this before, Talulah.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I've taught you—'In this period of excessive calm, they cannot accept mutual, equal treatment.'

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Not unless we draw this period of mediocrity to an end.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You and I may accept their autonomy, just as the Columbians and Siracusans have. But what of themselves?

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: They will elect their next consul, and their next lord. Because they do not esteem others. They only fear authority and violence.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Not only that. They don't allow for anyone braver than themselves, smarter than themselves. Kinder. More merciful... Not unless you are their duke, or their emperor.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You sympathize with them. You sympathize with my subjects, sympathize with such residents whose backs are forced against the wall by tax collectors and bureaucrats.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: That is wonderful.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Moreover, even you continue to force yourself to spit vile slurs that humiliate the Infected so... I do vaguely recall.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You constantly made revisions to my policies, in ever greater attempts to protect them, so much that you didn't even fear arousing the citizens' wrath.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I have spent a great deal of time ironing their moods out, Talulah.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm not sympathizing with them!

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You certainly do love them.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Why you...?!

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I'm very gratified, Talulah, that you should truly care for them. You've come to resemble me more and more, my daughter.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Who the hell gave you the right to keep saying this crap?!

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: But your superficial actions will not, and cannot succeed.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And what makes you think you know what I'm going to do? You don't have the power...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: No matter should all people in sum desire to reach one single good outcome——those people, as ever, still may fail.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Talulah, Talulah. It is because that golden outcome of theirs, and your daydreams, are fundamentally distinct.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You have no ability to make differing people endorse some identical action. Their disputes will clash and devolve, and that cannot be avoided.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: How can a Sarkaz face a Sankta? How can a soul from Kazimierz face a soul from Ursus? How can a sturdy yet toilsome bear face an arrogant yet impotent hippogryph?

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You think to let them know how to act? What an arrogant notion, my daughter! You wish to take this appearance and this rank of yours, and appeal to them to do something?

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Ah, of course, this I know. You certainly could do so.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Talulah, in time, you will rule those destined to follow you. You have inherited the Black Snake's knowledge, the Red Dragon's blood flows through you, you walk the Bear's land, and you thumb through the Hippogryph's history.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No person should be born to be ruled by another.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: But they crave your rule. For all their lives, they've been awaiting someone like you to rule over them. Ursus may well tremble for you, my daughter.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Those who rule others will inevitably be ruled themselves by the stronger, Kashchey.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Ah, now that is a concept close to me, Talulah. Let me give you your final lesson, then.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Talulah, we will come to transcend this sort of transient, worldly rule.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: The last Emperor is dead, yet his shadow is still cast upon these great lands of ours. His will, his force of mind, have already passed beyond that era.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: He inherited the true Empire of Ursus, sustains Ursus's flourishing lands, lets the people of Ursus live.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Should we lose the sun, the luxuriant branches and stems that Ursus grows will at once wither away, and all that will remain across this world is inferior creatures, ever more putrid, sucking the nutrients from each other.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: These people you have seen—

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: They take pleasure in savagery, widespread slaughter, masochism, and are at once fearful and selfish...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You dream of education and ideology to draw them in, enlighten them. But you don't know that they bear not the slightest interest in what you have to say... Talulah, you deserve to know this.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: They have survived across this world of ours for countless years, and have become accustomed to a certain deep-rooted way of life. You are merely but a stranger, crashing in on it.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: So-called rulers, so-called nobles, so-called armies... merely the people of strength, the people lapped in luxury, the people who withstood training.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Domains can shift, armies can rebuild, rules can fall to ruin...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: No rule can endure, except where the voluntary will of Ursus's people follows. They will never be ruled. They only press forth, forever.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: —The small charity you make is exchanged for obedience. For unrealistic expectations.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And how the hell would you know what they're meant to be?  It was Ursus that ravaged them to this point!

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I am very clear about it. Ah, I am all too clear about it.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: And this is why you think they will go with you? For their bread, their potatoes, their clean water and bonfires? Is this how you would promise them?

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: They will. And then, once they starve, their first thought will be to make a meal of your corpse.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: If you carry such unrealistic fantasies of them, you will hate them. You will surely hate them.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Kashchey, I am not you.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I am nothing whatsoever like you.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Yet you are already the same as me. You simply have not been roused from your daydreams yet.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: In truth, you can and may leverage all you have at hand.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: If you have some goal, then go. Use terror to destroy terror. Use life to rule life. Use sacrifice to guide sacrifice. Use ignorance to breed ignorance. Use suffering to manufacture suffering.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You have learned all of these methods. They are already your arms. All that's left is to learn to make use of them... to get used to them.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Until your beloved people understand, in the truest sense of the word, their country, and the significance of their existence.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I can't even tell what you're spouting all this hell-ridden doctrine for, if anything.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: All this is fact. All this, you will confront.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: How about this, my daughter. You don't trust me.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: So I wish to make a wager with you.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: In these many years, the Originium Arts I have cultivated in you have long since budded. Their time to fruit is already now.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...What... did...?

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: In your life to come, you need only raise doubt of all you persist in, you need only raise the slightest hatred of the ones you proclaim your compatriots, and those who you think ought to be free...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: And you will immediately settle this wager between us. It is whether, in that moment, you will walk the path I taught you.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Perhaps, in these coming years, you will be fortunate enough to avoid those conditions yet. You may, with sheer luck, be living within a fairytale land.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Perhaps the people before you will chance to have secret sorrows. They can be understood, explained—oh, they were forced into helplessness...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I can wait. This country can wait. Be it three years, five years, a decade, a century, you will only arrive at the same answer. Though you will not live an Infected's life for long, I know that day will come.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: The Empire of Ursus finds itself in a period of repeated ailment. Crops will not grow on the soil of the barrens. Soil in shadow can only bear forth flowers of corruption.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You may be betrayed by those you adored. You may witness the moments in which your friends die for you. You may realize the expectations you held for the future have lost all meaning.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Because all that you do, in other people's eyes, still cannot make up for the pressure you bring about with your appearance, your status.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You will realize it all can be sacrificed. You will realize that they all love themselves more than their neighbors. You will come to know that your proud struggle symbolizes nothing at all.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You will come to see. These great lands you threw yourself to do not want you.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You will see your thoughts, your actions, become nonexistence. You will see them spurn all you revered, your life, your dignity and philosophy void of all significance.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Because these people, who you suppose to call noble, are but ambling corpses.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: All I have encountered, you will encounter too.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You want... You want me to... surrender...!

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: No, no. I truly am using these Originium Arts. This is no deception, nor a threat.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Oh, that said, my Arts are utterly feeble. All I have taught you constitutes the foundations of these Arts.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: These Arts, in the moment you reject me, will carry no impact whatsoever.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: But should you recognize me, should you have understood me, should you realize just the sort of world you're standing in...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: —Tick, tock. Tick, tock. Chime. Chime. Chime.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You will become me.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Ursus's future will from then on be in your hands.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...What are you talking about?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What do you... what do you mean by all this?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Conscious manipulation? Thought suggestion? Have you gone insane? It was you who taught me to withstand these Arts! It was you who taught me how to break free from the psyche's Originium Arts!

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Why would I use such contemptible, destructive Arts on my own heir?

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: My Arts only expedited a course of events. Expedited your recognition of this great world of ours, your questioning yourself, doubting yourself, loathing yourself and seeing clearly, anew, your own course.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Sans these Arts, all this still would have happened. They were just to get you there a little faster.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Everyone in the city, living a make-believe normal life, has learned to hypnotize themselves.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: They are skilled in escaping from the facts, taming themselves with rules and morals. Using the lowly shell of the loser to hide just how easily harmed they are by cruel reality...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: But I have supplied you a set of armor, a sort of arms, and an ego.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: These can save you your self-doubt and self-harm, in the course of it all. Save you your distress, your struggle. Conserve your time. You will stand up ever faster than you were kicked down by reality, and you will be reborn.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You needn't spend too much of your life denying your own self.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: All I have taught you will once again bear anew within your mind, and you will, as if spinning silk from the cocoon, weave anew the knowledge.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You will rid yourself of your superstitions, and in your well-rounded garden of wisdom, find a path winding yet with certain end.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Talulah, Ursus's destiny breathes as one with you.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: The Black Snake shall walk with you. This immortal will shall never die.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: —You—

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Are you cursing me?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Are you trying... to use yourself... to mold me?

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: No, Talulah, this is not a curse. This is a blessing.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I bless you, my daughter.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: The moment you wake from your unrealistic fancy of human nature, you will be conscious. Of why we struggle so for this land's most beautiful future.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Yan language) Just shut it! You're... full of such utter shit!

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I never taught you such inflammatory Yan vernacular. But it may serve you to learn some. That's the role you'll be playing soon, after all.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Hah. Obviously. You didn't let me talk like this in public, so I'd maintain my so-called image—

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: —It was to cover you.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I calculate so as to make you think of others, but you denounce my proposals, profane my language. You've remembered all I've taught you, and now want to flee, Talulah...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: But I'm not worried. Because, in the end, you will come back to this path.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: The space between people is filled with hatred, and by that hatred, they are ruled. Love births hate. Indecision births hate. Admiration births hate.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Hatred is the inevitable outcome of interaction. It takes as little as two people to facilitate a sort of rule. Unless they are like me, and love all people equally.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Will you hate me, Talulah? For what I have done, this world will do to you. That is all.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What you do has nothing to do with me... nothing at all.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'll have no part of it! None!

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Ah... good. Truly splendid.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: To not inherit the name, to not harness the authority, to not exploit the position. Wonderful, my child. You have great resolve.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Go and establish your cause by your own hand. If you don't wish to inherit my domain and political resources, my wealth and my power, then by all means.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You may seize them yourself. That you could do so would still fulfill my greatest dreams.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No one told you you could define my aspirations!

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: No, no, of course I wouldn't dream of doing so. But know well, no Kashchey would be willing to accept such a 'present.'  To our diligent, prideful selves, it would be an insult!

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I have already taught you everything I can.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: As for all your goals from here on, they will be your own.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: My daughter... you truly are outstanding.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: You break off from all you've known without a second thought, in exchange for a new, novel path...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: The Infected will open up a very different sort of territory for you. Your actions upon this land we call Ursus will be unprecedented.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (She unsheathes her sword.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I only came face-to-face with you today for one thing. I didn't think I'd be forced to sit through your wicked, venomous sermon.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Ah. Have I been waiting for this day?

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I often wondered if Wei Yenwu missed the chance to kill me and instead would send one of his hands to do it?  So it was you, it was—always going to be you.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: To be an executioner for the one who murdered your father, and in place of him who you bear hatred, to kill who he hates. Oh, what a beautiful outcome.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Your slaughter testifies to my point of view. I shall gladly give up resistance, and die by your hand, my daughter. This action will form your bridge towards truth, and allow my death to forge your foundations.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm not your daughter... I'm not.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm killing you to put a stop to your evil, once and for all.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: And then, Talulah, you. You will do evil.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I've heard enough.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: And then you will do good. And you will recognize all the good I did.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Ah. This sword. I never had the housekeeper confiscate it... I'm not fond of this sword. You use Arts much more than you use swords... but you were still allowed to carry it.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: It will remind you where you came from...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (A great roar.)

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: ...and it will witness our path, yours and mine.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Do you hate me, Talulah?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I won't be taken in, you rotting, putrid snake! You're a villain beyond all else! Your life ends here!

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: *hiss*, *cough*, *hiss*, *hiss*...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Only the lobe... of my lung... *hiss*...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Your strike... was not... accurate.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I won't hate you, Kashchey.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I may hate your endless, long-winded, rancid sophistry, but you yourself haven't earned my hate.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I pity you. Your death only testifies to your loneliness, your vain attempt to turn yourself into a mirage.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'll let you know the sheer absurdity of all you espoused. Not that you'd be able to know, now.

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: Hah, hah... wonder... ful...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: With my death, Wei may feel... a weight off him, too...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: I look forward... to when... you bare... your regret... your... hate...

steps.name: Kashchey
steps.text: ...Remember this...
Talulah, remember this.
Your end is in me.
Talulah, very carefully, pulls out the sword from the Duke's chest.
Her mind is somewhere far, far away. She leaves the towering castle, leaves the city, outruns her pursuers...
The seeds, already planted, waiting only to sprout.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: And so you came all the way to where we were.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: All of that was years ago, now.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: ...After Kashchey died, did anything happen in the city? Did you run into any trouble?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If anything else happened, I probably wouldn't have ever reached your village.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The city... After I left, I heard Kashchey's domain and wealth were quickly carved up amongst the Fourth Army.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And as far as I go, nobody cares. Who'd care about some... *chuckle* city girl? Not when she made herself scarce.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I did wander too far, though. I only came to my senses once I was already at the old couple's place.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Trust me, back then, my brain was the picture of a mess. I can barely even remember what I encountered along the way.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Ma'am said that the day you came, you were bloody, tip to tail. It was half a miracle she could still wash those clothes clean.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Did you ever wonder, if maybe our village would secretly kill you?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Wait, where's this coming from?!

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Well... I'm just guessing, you must've thought of it.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You wouldn't do that. Your harvests were good, you'd just put out the evening dance's bonfire, you had fenced burdenbeasts, and decorations hung outside on the walls...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Your lives might've been tough, but you still enjoyed how you lived.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You wouldn't have killed me. After that, not even the dance would feel right anymore.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Who kills someone and stays calm as a lake? Only vicious monsters would. And they're not common at all.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Don't you think you're too optimistic about people?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I've seen too many bad things. In so many cases, they were done by those without another choice.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If they had the choice to make, I know that the vast majority of people, across the whole wide world, would choose to be good people.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...And nothing like what Kashchey said.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: He said that all people were disgraceful, that you'd hate them and their evil in the end, all because you were so kind-hearted.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: ...What a horrible curse to want to make. It's about as poisonous as words can get.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And that's why I'm sure I'll never hate anyone. Everything they do has a reason behind it.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Do you want me to watch over you?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Maybe that wouldn't be so bad.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: But what about after I'm gone? You'd have to figure things out on your own then.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's bad luck to be so ominous, you know.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: We'll always have to confront it. Us little Infected sooner or later have to make our exits.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Taking the little time we have left, and doing something that makes the fact we live worthwhile... there's nothing bad about that.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: *chuckle*. I think the same way.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It might not be easy, Alina, it might not be easy, but I still believe the Infected should reunite as one.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We should find where we belong again in Ursus. If possible, this world should in turn examine its own deeds.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: After that, it's not just the Infected... not just the Infected.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Whether Ursus, Victoria, Leithanien, regardless of country, regardless of race, regardless of your background... we'll sear away all these things that divide us.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We should all have lives where we deserve to be equally loved. If someone stands in the way of that life, then we'll take back what's rightfully ours.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: If you want to do it, you could give it a trial run first.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: We'd probably be wiped out to the last.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Wasn't your first step to challenge Ursus, anyway?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No matter what we do, it's all a challenge to Ursus.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But when we give some, we gain some. Despite the fact the return isn't certain to be for us.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: I can't call to mind things as wicked as you could... but my impression is that things in this world might not be as good as you often suppose.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You mean?

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Talulah, do you only give so that you can gain?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Alina, no. That's not right. What you're asking for is... too...

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: I know. But you need to think that way.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I won't. I—I definitely won't.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I believe all we've done will bear good fruit, and the reason is simple to match. Because they deserve that result. Because the creatures of this world deserve that fruit.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: ...Mm. Okay. Let's go.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: Are you going to join with the guerrillas?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I need them to approve of me first.

steps.name: Alina
steps.text: It'll be difficult.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It'll take more than difficulty to slow me down.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: FrostNova! Here's the... person who helped us back there!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Keep your bolts nocked.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: *Phew*... *huff*.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You're just like the rumors say. So cold, you Yetis. Cold enough to outstrip this awful winter weather.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Are you their commander?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Infected?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You need to explain, then. Why are you wearing an Ursus military officer's uniform?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I've come up with a lot of lies for that. Any preference?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Fire.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Wait!  You just don't do humor, do you? Are you the Yeti Squad's leader?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Why haven't you fired?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: She really... did just... help us now, Sister. Promise.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's true, Yetis. I came here to seek assistance, as well as to assist you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...Assist us?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Let's shake on it, Captain Yeti! When conveying sincerity, I always hope to go the equal and dignified route.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I hope we can both have ourselves a dignified, tranquil, level dialogue.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Try it. I think I've pegged who you are.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Those Originium crystals they're carrying have your Arts, don't they?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: If I'm able to melt your ice, would you be willing to hear me out for a bit?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: —Dream on. You couldn't.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Let's try it.
